Exhibited game A=[[0,1,3],[0,3,0],[2,2,1]], B=[[0,1,3],[2,3,1],[2,1,0]] independently re-verified: operational non-degeneracy (unique pure best responses + no support-2 third-tie on either side) passes under two independent implementations including a definition-based brute-force check; exhaustive 19-support-pair exact-rational enumeration reproduces exactly the 7 listed equilibria with stated supports, x,y, indifference equalities and strict deviation inequalities (e.g. fully-mixed y=(1/11,6/11,4/11) gives row payoffs 18/11 x3, x=(3/8,1/8,1/2) gives column payoffs 5/4 x3); odd count 7, fully-mixed presence, max welfare 6 at two pure equilibria, next distinct 4, gap 2 all re-derived. originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: nearest lines are (a) Nash 1950 existence, (b) Lemke-Howson/Mangasarian 1964 general pivoting method, (c) von Stengel equilibrium enumeration/support bounds, (d) Quint-Shubik/Wilson generic oddness, (e) Papadimitriou PPAD + Gambit general solver. None tabulates exact one-sided admissibility counts per support size over the non-degenerate 3x3 {0,1,2,3} cube (57344/31104/34032) nor exhibits this specific 7-equilibrium integer-cube game with fully-mixed rational strategies (3/8,1/8,1/2; 1/11,6/11,4/11) and welfare gap 2. General oddness predicts odd counts but does not imply the exact table or witness; support bounds constrain but do not mechanically imply exact cube counts; Gambit computes equilibria generally but provides no logged per-pattern census of this bounded cube with replay. Internal prior scan consistent: 20 success findings concern unrelated objects; closest failure SCOPE-FAIL-20260907-013 (4x4 max-2x2-count via vertex enumeration) uses different object/claim/route. The exact marginal table + concrete 7-equilibrium certificate are substantively new.

value.rationale: Strongest self-contained headline judged separately from unfinished joint survey: exhibited non-degenerate 3x3 {0,1,2,3} game with exactly 7 Nash equilibria including a certified fully-mixed rational equilibrium and maximal-welfare gap 2, plus exact one-sided admissibility counts (1x1 57344, 2x2 31104, 3x3 34032) via proved factorization. Evaluated under narrow-datum rule: object is natural and motivated before computation (3x3 minimal for fully-mixed 3x3 supports; {0,1,2,3} smallest alphabet with nontrivial indifference; recognized Nash/Lemke-Howson/von Stengel/oddness/PPAD-selection frontier demanding small-game ground truth); values were not known or mechanically implied; future selection/enumeration/oddness work could reasonably need this precise benchmark ground truth and oddness realization. Not a textbook restatement (2x2 486-core and 3x3 Cramer-sign count are non-trivial exhaustive facts), not mere parameter substitution, not an unexplained enumeration (every count rebuilt from payoff entries with inequality replay + named witnesses). Incomplete joint census is honestly disclaimed and does not erase the independently valuable exact headline result; no general criterion/completed census/downstream theorem is demanded beyond the admitted claim.
